data.narrative:
CesiumAstro is a Series C-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised $470M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 private peers at the same stage and funding level, alongside 5 public Space & Aerospace equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) for sector context.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding $799M. Peer-median valuation across same-stage Space & Aerospace competitors (Sierra Space at $8.0B, Varda Space Industries at $1.5B, and Skyryse at $1.1B) produces a median of $1.5B, though the range spans $1.1B to $8.0B, reflecting wide dispersion within the cohort. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because CesiumAstro's revenue is not disclosed; the sector median P/S of 23.9x across public comparables is therefore not actionable.

The two applicable methods triangulate to a range of $679M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $1.1B. This range reflects meaningful uncertainty around whether CesiumAstro converges toward stage-based progression norms or toward the peer-median valuation. Key unknowns include revenue scale, growth trajectory, and market positioning relative to the wide dispersion observed in peer valuations—particularly whether circumstances more closely resemble Skyryse ($1.1B) or the higher-valued Varda comparables.
